title: Base tray
desc: Zinc-plated steel tray; mounts deck posts, PSU and air handler. Ground bond point.

title: Anti-vibration foot
desc: Silicone foot, Shore 40A — damps bench vibration during imaging.

title: Thread-forming screw
desc: M3.5 × 16 thread-forming screw (PT-style) from under the base into a molded boss; heads sit on the underside, never on an A-surface. Confirm pilot and boss OD with the screw maker.

title: Internal deck
desc: Structural deck separating the dry electronics bay from the conditioned chamber.

title: Deck post
desc: Folded steel standoff.

title: Six-position carousel
desc: Anodised aluminium turntable indexes each dish under the imaging head. Lifts out tool-free for cleaning.

title: Position index
desc: Laser-etched position numbers match the on-screen map.

title: Quick-release knob
desc: Knurled quarter-turn knob (30 flutes = "rotate") releases the carousel from the drive hub.

title: Drive shaft
desc: Ground stainless shaft through a sealed bearing.

title: Sealed bearing
desc: Lip-sealed bearing keeps humid chamber air out of the drive bay.

title: Drive pulley
desc: GT2 60T pulley driven from a 16T motor pulley (1:3.75).

title: Carousel stepper
desc: NEMA 17 closed-loop stepper with magnetic encoder — detects a jammed dish and stops.

title: Motor pulley
desc: GT2 16T

title: GT2 belt
desc: Glass-fibre reinforced timing belt.

title: Home sensor
desc: Slotted optical switch homes the carousel on every start.

title: Dish retainers
desc: Three spring ball plungers per pocket hold the dish against the counterbore while the carousel indexes.

title: Calibration target
desc: Ceramic 4 × 4 colour/grey target imaged with every rotation, so white balance and exposure are corrected per frame.

title: Chamber liner
desc: Electropolished 316L stainless with 15 mm coved corners and no internal fasteners, for straightforward wipe-down.

title: Laminar air baffle
desc: Perforated rear plenum that spreads low-velocity airflow across all six dishes.

title: Door gasket
desc: Food-grade silicone D-profile seal.

title: Chamber trim
desc: Molded trim closing the chamber to the cover. Its R28.5 corner is concentric with the door's R34 hood, so the gap and gasket stay constant all the way round.

title: Chamber light
desc: Dimmable white LED bar for viewing dishes through the door; switched off automatically during imaging.

title: Temp / RH probe
desc: Digital temperature and humidity sensor behind a PTFE membrane, with an independent over-temperature sensor.

title: UV-C decontamination bar
desc: UV-C LED bar runs a surface decontamination cycle between experiments; door-interlocked.

title: Insulation panel
desc: Molded EPP bead foam that follows the rounded shell, so the thickened side walls are insulated right into the corners. The outboard face is dimpled: the dimples hold a still-air layer against the cover and act as crush points that take up cover tolerance. The smooth face seats on the liner.
spec: EPP 45 g/L molded bead foam, dimpled outer face (Ø10 × 2.5 on 13 hex)

title: Insulation blanket
desc: Only 3.5 mm between the liner and the saddle ribs — too thin to mold in EPP, so the top uses a silica-aerogel blanket bonded to the liner.

title: Supply grille
desc: Conditioned air from the Peltier stack enters high on the right wall and sweeps down across the carousel.

title: Return grille
desc: Low return on the left wall closes the loop under the carousel, so air passes every dish at the same speed.

title: Mist outlet
desc: Ultrasonic humidifier outlet, PP nozzle; condensate drains back to the reservoir.

title: Condensate drain
desc: Slotted drain at the low corner of the coved floor returns condensate to the humidifier reservoir.

title: Rating etch
desc: Laser-etched operating envelope on the chamber wall.

title: Air handler
desc: Sealed duct: chamber air is pulled through the floor return, conditioned, HEPA-filtered and returned via the rear baffle.

title: Cold-side heat exchanger
desc: Inside the sealed duct; the Peltier heat pump can both heat and cool the chamber.

title: Peltier module
desc: Thermoelectric module — solid state, no refrigerant, reversible for heating.

title: Hot-side heatsink
desc: Extruded aluminium sink exhausting through the rear grille.

title: Exhaust fan
desc: 80 mm PWM fan, speed-controlled on hot-side temperature.

title: Recirculation blower
desc: Low-velocity centrifugal blower recirculating chamber air.

title: PTC safety heater
desc: Self-limiting PTC element for warm-up.

title: HEPA filter
desc: H13 HEPA on the return air to capture airborne spores released by mature colonies.

title: Front console
desc: Graphite PC console angled at 47.5° so the screen and label printer face the operator at the bench.

title: Status light pipe
desc: Run-state line along the foot of the console, readable across the lab and kept out of the finger scoop.

title: 10.1" touchscreen
desc: Optically-bonded 10.1" 1280×800 IPS with glove-mode capacitive touch and a chemically-strengthened cover glass.

title: Display surface
desc: Active area

title: LCD module
desc: Backlit IPS panel in steel frame.

title: Display driver board
desc: eDP/MIPI bridge + touch controller, FFC to compute module.

title: Dish 1
desc: Standard 90 mm polystyrene Petri dish. Seats in a counterbored pocket that locates it under the camera.

title: Dish 1 culture
desc: Synthetic illustration of colony morphology used for rendering — not a photograph.

title: Dish 1 barcode
desc: Printed on-device, applied to the dish wall; the side scanner links it to the run.

title: Gull-wing door frame
desc: Graphite PC frame on damped torque hinges — opens up and back so both hands stay free for dishes.

title: Heated front glazing
desc: Double-glazed with a heated inner pane so condensation does not obscure the view of the dishes.

title: Heated top glazing
desc: Top window gives a clear overhead view of all six dishes.

title: Torque hinge
desc: Constant-torque friction hinge, holds the door at any angle.

title: Finger pull
desc: Lip under the door rail that fingers hook from the console scoop; works with gloved hands.

title: Interlock magnet
desc: Pairs with a Hall sensor; UV-C and carousel motion stop when the door opens.

title: Compute board
desc: Quad-core ARM compute module: UI, camera pipeline, on-device colony detection, encrypted store-and-forward sync.

title: Real-time control board
desc: Safety MCU runs PID climate control, stepper motion and interlocks independent of the UI computer.

title: Power supply
desc: Enclosed 24 V power supply, universal input.

title: Base band
desc: One-piece ring carrying the R24 roll under every bottom edge, so the form closes on itself instead of stopping at the bench and fingers find an edge to lift by. Pulled straight down (no undercut); its horizontal 0.8 mm reveal at z 40 continues the console's lower edge all the way round. A 4 mm step lip rises behind the upper parts; retained by six snap hooks onto the tray edge (not modelled).
spec: PC/ABS, 3.0 mm wall, MT-11010 · Lab White #ECEEF2

title: Side panel
desc: Mirrored pair from one family tool, pulled along X. Carries the full side profile and the R32 roll; the parting line sits on the roll tangent and meets the saddle in a 0.8 mm reveal. Two M3.5 thread-forming screws into gusseted bosses from under the base — no visible fasteners.
spec: PC/ABS, 3.0 mm wall, MT-11010 · Lab White #ECEEF2

title: Top saddle
desc: Top and back in one L-shaped molding pulled on the 45° diagonal so both faces draft. Step lips run under both reveals; ribs stiffen the 430 mm span; two rear bosses take the screws from below.
spec: PC/ABS, 3.0 mm wall, MT-11010 · Lab White #ECEEF2

title: Lift handhold
desc: Finger recess molded up into the base band's underside roll, sized for four fingers: hands slide under the R24 edge and hook in, away from the door and screen.

title: Side accent inlay
desc: Navy inlay insert-molded into the side panel; the colour break marks the grip zone above the finger recess.

title: Water reservoir
desc: Slide-out reservoir behind a rear hatch; float sensor warns before it runs dry.

title: Reservoir hatch
desc: Rear hatch — refill without opening the chamber.

title: Ultrasonic atomiser
desc: Ultrasonic piezo atomiser — humidifies without a heating element.

title: Mist tube
desc: Silicone line into the air handler outlet.

title: Transillumination panel
desc: Edge-lit LED panel under the imaging station; back-lighting reveals translucent and early micro-colonies.

title: Imaging head
desc: Sealed, heated optical head. Fixed working distance to the dish plane — no autofocus drift between time-points.

title: Anti-fog window
desc: AR-coated window, heated 2 °C above chamber air.

title: Multispectral ring light
desc: 24 LEDs in four channels (white, 365 nm UV, 470 nm, 850 nm IR) for pigment, fluorescence and texture contrast.

title: Cross-polarised diffuser
desc: Diffuser with linear polariser; paired with a lens polariser to kill agar glare.

title: Fixed-focal lens
desc: Low-distortion lens stopped down for full-dish depth of field.

title: Image sensor board
desc: 12 MP colour sensor; about 25 µm per pixel across a 100 mm field of view.

title: Camera ribbon
desc: MIPI CSI-2 flat flex to compute module.

title: Head heater
desc: Polyimide heater keeps optics above dew point.

title: Printer door
desc: Push-to-open door with a concave Ø16 mm press dimple; label roll drops in, no threading.

title: Label exit + tear bar
desc: Serrated tear bar; labels presented at the operator.

title: Printer chassis
desc: Folded steel chassis carrying a direct-thermal line printer mechanism.

title: Label roll
desc: Chemical-resistant synthetic labels sized for 90 mm dish side-walls. Drop-in loading.

title: Platen roller
desc: Silicone platen, stepper-driven.

title: Thermal print head
desc: Direct-thermal line head.

title: Feed motor
desc: PM stepper for label feed.

title: Rear I/O
desc: IEC inlet with fused switch, Gigabit Ethernet, 2× USB-A (scanner/keyboard/export), USB-C service port.
spec: IEC C14, RJ45 1 GbE, 2× USB-A, USB-C

title: Side barcode scanner
desc: Present a labelled dish to the side window — 1D/2D imager reads it without opening the door.

title: Imager engine
desc: Area imager with red aimer and white illumination.

title: Harness
desc: Keyed, latching connectors throughout — every sub-assembly is field-swappable.
